reason: We go into the new country next year, so I am not paying EUR 1,500 this month for meetings my team can't follow up yet. I would take the free sample of 15 companies, though, and use it to check whether they really understand our buyers.
objection: Our buyers are engineers and procurement people who buy on specs and long relationships. I doubt cold emails from a Sofia agency get me real buying conversations rather than polite calls that look good on a report. A logistics company getting 45 meetings tells me nothing about manufacturing.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample names buyers I recognise as the right ones, and I can talk to a past manufacturing or export client about meetings that turned into orders, I would book a start date for Q1.
